report.explanation: Alert reports checkout error-rate and latency, but current telemetry is largely healthy: gateway error_rate 0.0014, p95 71ms, INFO 200 logs; order checkout trace OK at 1050ms; inventory/payment healthy. Order shows retained heap after GC (260MB, 4 WARNs) and a 7-minute-old deploy, but a short increase alone cannot establish a leak and the deployment record cannot establish latency causation. No bounded candidate is substantiated; hand off for the missing evidence.
missing_evidence: Traces/logs showing the actual failing checkout requests and their error status, since current traces show OK and logs show 200
Gateway error-rate and latency metrics over a longer window to confirm the alert vs the 0.0014 error rate and p95 71ms observed
Order memory-retention time series across multiple windows to distinguish a leak from a transient retained-heap increase
Order heap/GC metrics and allocation profile to substantiate or rule out memory-leak
Order dependency latency breakdown (inventory, payment, postgresql) to test downstream-latency
